title: Enabling Tracy on macOS can crash the game process on shutdown
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.6.dev [8105ff7ac735f83be221296a6bb9b22caa7d9253]

### System information

Godot v4.6.dev (8105ff7ac) - macOS Tahoe (26.1.0) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M2 Pro (Apple8) - Apple M2 Pro (10 threads) - 32.00 GiB memory

### Issue description

When running a game built with `profiler=tracy profiler_path=/path/to/tracy`, while using a custom `MainLoop` written in GDScript, the global-scope `godot_cleanup_profiler()` function is called _before_ the `MainLoop` has its `_finalize` method called, which means that when `_finalize` is called `TracyInternal::configured` is `false`, leading to a crash here:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/8105ff7ac735f83be221296a6bb9b22caa7d9253/core/profiling/profiling.cpp#L117

... with the following backtrace:

```
TracyInternal::intern_source_location(void const*, StringName const&, StringName const&, unsigned int) (core/profiling/profiling.cpp:117)
GDScriptFunction::call(GDScriptInstance*, Variant const**, int, Callable::CallError&, GDScriptFunction::CallState*) (modules/gdscript/gdscript_vm.cpp:499)
GDScriptInstance::callp(StringName const&, Variant const**, int, Callable::CallError&) (modules/gdscript/gdscript.cpp:2059)
MainLoop::_gdvirtual__finalize_call() (core/os/main_loop.h:45)
MainLoop::finalize() (core/os/main_loop.cpp:70)
SceneTree::finalize() (scene/main/scene_tree.cpp:860)
OS_MacOS_NSApp::cleanup() (platform/macos/os_macos.mm:1171)
-[GodotApplicationDelegate applicationWillTerminate:] (platform/macos/godot_application_delegate.mm:302)
__CFNOTIFICATIONCENTER_IS_CALLING_OUT_TO_AN_OBSERVER__
___CFXRegistrationPost_block_invoke
_CFXRegistrationPost
_CFXNotificationPost
-[NSNotificationCenter postNotificationName:object:userInfo:]
-[NSApplication terminate:]
OS_MacOS_NSApp::terminate() (platform/macos/os_macos.mm:1166)
invocation function for block in OS_MacOS_NSApp::start_main() (platform/macos/os_macos.mm:1131)
__CFRUNLOOP_IS_CALLING_OUT_TO_AN_OBSERVER_CALLBACK_FUNCTION__
__CFRunLoopDoObservers
__CFRunLoopRun
_CFRunLoopRunSpecificWithOptions
RunCurrentEventLoopInMode
ReceiveNextEventCommon
_BlockUntilNextEventMatchingListInMode
_DPSBlockUntilNextEventMatchingListInMode
_DPSNextEvent
-[NSApplication(NSEventRouting) _nextEventMatchingEventMask:untilDate:inMode:dequeue:]
-[NSApplication(NSEventRouting) nextEventMatchingMask:untilDate:inMode:dequeue:]
-[NSApplication run]
OS_MacOS_NSApp::run() (platform/macos/os_macos.mm:1079)
main (platform/macos/godot_main_macos.mm:133)
start
```

### Steps to reproduce

1. Run the main scene of the MRP under a debugger
2. Press Escape
3. Note the crash

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[macos-profiling-crash.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23915394/macos-profiling-crash.zip)
